from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAssetEntry(BaseModel):
    """
    Extracted data representing the fixed asset information for one company from a single document.
    """
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company, e.g., 'Shenzhen Zhenye (Group) Co., Ltd.'")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Security/Stock code associated with the company")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="End date of the reporting period, e.g., '2025-03-31' or '2025-03'")
    fixed_assets_net_value: float | None = Field(description="Net fixed assets value at reporting date end, as a numeric float")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported value, e.g., 'Yuan' or 'CNY'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fixed_asset_entries: list[CompanyFixedAssetEntry]
